name: Ijebu
description: Coastal Ogun Yoruba lect known for u-vowel shifts (usu for isu) and e-initial nouns (ẹdiyẹ for adìyẹ).

name: Ekiti
description: Highland eastern Yoruba lect preserving distinct vowel harmony and respectful compound greetings.

name: Ondo
description: Southeastern Yoruba lect sharing u-initial and e-initial lexical shifts with distinct tonal cadences.

name: Owerri (Isuama)
description: Heartland Imo Igbo lect featuring rich consonant aspiration, nasalization, and warm kinship greetings.

name: Onitsha
description: Riverine commercial Igbo lect spoken along the Niger with distinct market and royal salutations.

name: Ikwerre
description: Southern Igboid lect where plural children shifts from ụmụ to rụmụ in community and compound names.

name: Kano Hausa
description: Classical commercial Hausa of Kurmi Market and ancient Kano city walls, rich in polite bargaining formulas.

name: Lagos Pidgin
description: Fast-paced urban lingua franca of Lagos transit corridors, markets, and everyday street camaraderie.
